result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders mostly correctly, but there is a clear data formatting bug ("€NaN delivery") in the "Fastest near you" carousel, plus several layout/consistency issues: the third carousel card is cut off with a truncated restaurant name, and the favorite heart buttons on the "Popular right now" cards use inconsistent styling.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, indicating an undefined/non-numeric value is being passed into the currency formatter.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined/non-numeric fee values before formatting; show a fallback such as 'Free delivery' or hide the fee line when data is unavailable.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the right screen edge and its title is cut off without visible ellipsis, so the item looks broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent horizontal padding/peek width to the carousel so the next card is partially revealed intentionally, and truncate titles with an ellipsis within the card width.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently — one has a white/light circular background with a dark outline heart, the other has a dark translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, size, and icon color across all cards for a consistent look and reliable contrast over any image.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible title or metadata, making the section end abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom scroll padding equal to the nav bar height so the last card can be fully scrolled into view.

issues.description: The notification bell and heart icon buttons are icon-only with no visible label; the red dot badge conveys state by color/shape alone.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread', 'Add to favorites') and ensure badge state is exposed to screen readers.
